records.name: dda-west
records.observation: The DDA describes a 2010 shared pedestrian/vehicle design connecting Pine and Linden streets, including delivery and waste-service functions. This describes design context, not the state or ordinary-car operating policy of the retained gate node.
records.title: Old Firehouse Alley West

records.name: dda-east
records.observation: The DDA describes the east alley connection and a spur to Walnut Street. This is location/design context and supplies no operating rule for the retained gate.
records.quote: between Linden Street and Chestnut Street
records.title: Old Firehouse Alley East and Seckner Alley

records.name: city-parking
records.observation: The City describes three parking garages, including Firehouse Alley at 165 Chestnut Street, as gateless and open around the clock. Garage guidance does not establish operation of a separate alley gate.
records.title: Where to Park
